items.title: Bihar Cabinet hikes 3% DA for employees, pensioners
items.text: The Bihar Cabinet approved a 3-percentage-point rise in dearness allowance for state government employees and dearness relief for pensioners, effective 1 July 2026. Under the Seventh Pay Commission, the rate increases from 60% to 63%.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh Cabinet clears policy frameworks to attract investments in AI, electronics, renewable energy
items.text: Directorate of Traffic Management and Road Safety to be set up at Mangalagiri; ₹31,387-crore green integrated AI data centre proposed by AM Intelligence at Amanam in Visakhapatnam district cleared

items.title: Blackstone to buy about 16% stake in India's IIFL Finance for $535 million
items.text: The proposed transaction would give Blackstone about a 16% stake in IIFL Finance for $535 million. Existing investors Nirmal Jain and R. Venkataraman would also invest ₹12.64 billion, while Anchorage Capital would invest another ₹1.5 billion.

items.title: New Israeli parliament to take aim at Netanyahu as Eisenkot seeks government
items.text: President Isaac Herzog opened the new parliamentary session and urged lawmakers to work together to avoid another election. The report described the country as deeply polarised and weary after three years of war.

items.title: Telangana Deputy CM urges banks to restructure crop loans in drought-hit areas
items.text: At the State Level Bankers’ Committee meeting, Deputy CM Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka urged banks to restructure eligible crop loans and speed up Rabi credit. Telangana had declared 365 mandals across 31 districts drought-affected, including 111 severely affected. Banks were asked to sanction ₹38,268 crore in Rabi crop loans; only 53% of the ₹96,943 crore overall agricultural lending target had been achieved by September.
